sections.en: 3 ἡ ('the') omitted by M [“ proceeding to his home Avenar „]. αὐτοῦ ('of him') : namely μέριμνα αὐτοῦ ('his care'). 4 Σελήνης ('of the Moon') omitted by P. διότι ('because') - Καρκίνος ('Cancer') omitted by M. 6 ἔχουσαν ('having') P M. γείτονας ('neighbors') M [“ with her her relatives and acquaintances, she herself desiring the port „ Albumasar]. 7 ἔχουσα μέριμναν ('having care') M. αὐτῆς ('of her') omitted by M. 8 διότι ('because') - ἐστίν ('is') omitted by M. 9 ἕως ('until') - γυμνός ('naked') omitted by M. 10 After λῃστάς ('robbers') these things follow in P M : Καὶ ἡ πρώτη κάταρξις ὁ Σκορπίος καὶ <ὁ> Ὑδροχόος <καὶ> ('And the first beginning is Scorpio and Aquarius and') οἱ Ἰχθύες [αὐτῶν] ὅταν ὦσιν ('Pisces [of them] whenever they are') (εἰσιν ('they are') P) ἀνατολικοὶ καὶ προσθετικοὶ καὶ εὔδρομοι ('oriental and additive and swift-running') (εὐδόκιμοι ('esteemed') P), διότι τότε εἰσὶ δυνατοί. καὶ ἡ δύναμις αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ψήφῳ ταύτῃ ('because then they are powerful. and their power in this calculation') (omitted by M) ἡ βασιλεία. ('the kingdom.'). That these things do not pertain here is manifest. 12 οὗ ('of which')] ὃν ('which') M. 19 ἰητροῦ ('of the physician') is the only trace of the original form; in the following four chapters likewise drawn from Dorotheus nothing of this kind survives. 22 Πρὸ ('Before')] πρὸς ('towards') M. 24 ἤτοι ('or') = namely; a star which was previously hidden and square or diametrical to the Moon, when it rises, also changes its radiation. 26 This chapter too was taken from Dorotheus you would conclude from the place it occupies; the same seems to be in cod. Flor. 12, f. 24, and in Veneto 7, f. 68v.

summary.headline: Pisces Decans and Medical Astrology
summary.text: Descriptions of the three Pisces decans assigned to Jupiter, the Moon, and Mars, followed by Dorotheus’s astrological method for diagnosing illness through the ascendant, angles, Moon, malefics, benefics, and stellar configurations, plus a heading on vomiting and purging.
